_doc: Manifest of the real/cross-tool reference corpus (docs/VERIFICATION_PLAN.md, Phase 2). The image FILES live in tests/corpus/ (gitignored, copyright-restricted) or tests/corpus_free/ (tracked, rights-free self-created content); this manifest (sha256 + provenance) is the in-repo truth so third parties can re-acquire and verify the corpus. Entries with origin='real' rate a format T1, origin='cross-tool' rate T1b — in both cases only if the named ctest test exists and consumes the image. Consumed by scripts/gen_verification_tiers.py.

_entry_schema.sha256: hex digest of the image file
_entry_schema.origin: 'real' (hardware dump / original file) or 'cross-tool' (produced by a canonical third-party tool)
_entry_schema.tool: producing tool + version for cross-tool entries (e.g. 'VICE 3.8 c1541')
_entry_schema.source: provenance: where/how the image was obtained or generated (reproducible for cross-tool)
_entry_schema.test: ctest test name that opens this image through the UFT plugin

images.source: c1541 -format "uftcorpus,42" d64 -write marker.txt "uft marker"; marker.txt is original UFT text (rights-free)
xdftool create + format "UFTCORPUS" ofs + write marker.txt; marker.txt is original UFT text (rights-free)

images.tool: atrcopy 10.1 template dos2sd.atr (pristine, byte-identical to the pip package artifact)
images.source: atrcopy templates/dos2sd.atr: 'Atari 8-bit DOS 2 single density (90K), empty VTOC' — filesystem structure only, no copyrighted DOS files

zxart.ee release id 428381 (https://zxart.ee/releasefile/id:428381/SP1_O.zip), file SP1_O.fdi — freely distributed disk magazine; local-only (tests/corpus/ gitignored), re-acquire from the URL and verify this hash
c1541 -format "uftcorpus,42" d71 -write marker.txt "uft marker"; marker.txt is original UFT text (rights-free)
c1541 -format "uftcorpus,42" d81 -write marker.txt "uft marker"; marker.txt is original UFT text (rights-free)
gw convert --format=amiga.amigados tests/corpus_free/xdftool_dd_ofs.adf out.hfe — canonical MFM encoding of the rights-free xdftool ADF
